_comment: Per PLAYBOOK.md step 3 (high-cut-rate recipe), reworked to drop every human-character asset in favor of infographics -- no talking-mouth characters anywhere in this video. 12 single-file image assets + 6 pure-code (no image) motion graphics, each reused across many shots in shotlist.json with a different overlay/variant rather than regenerated per shot. imageType suffix (A/B) refers to the two prompt templates in production/strait-of-hormuz-reference/STYLE_GUIDE.md (A = character/dramatized scene template -- now unused; B = map/establishing/infographic template, used by everything below).

assets.description: flat vector official document/form with a letterhead bar and a wax-seal stamp, no character -- replaces the export-official clerk for establishing/idle beats
flat vector blank whiteboard on a stand with a marker tray, no character -- replaces the narrator-analyst figure for the ProgressiveReveal text-build beats
flat vector 3-stage flow diagram: ore rock -> refining flask (highlighted in accent color as the bottleneck, labeled REFINING) -> magnet, connected by arrows
flat vector world map, Vox bold-data-viz palette (ink ocean, red/yellow landmasses), no labels baked in (labels/pins added as Remotion overlay)
flat vector map of China, Vox bold-data-viz palette, no labels baked in
flat vector map of the continental United States with California region distinguishable, Vox bold-data-viz palette, no labels baked in
flat vector isolated lanthanide row of the periodic table, 17 plain element tiles, no chemical symbols needed at establishing distance
flat vector stylized sintered permanent magnet icon (simple horseshoe/block shape), single reusable glyph
used_in: every 'this contains rare earths' callout across all chapters

assets.description: flat vector icon set: EV motor cutaway, wind turbine, MRI machine, fighter jet, smartphone -- simple single-color silhouettes, one image with 5 sub-icons to crop from
flat vector bird's-eye terraced open-pit mine illustration (concentric rings + mining trucks), California desert setting, wide establishing shot
used_in: THE GRUDGE boom/bust/reopen beats (reused 3x with different color grade/era dressing + stat overlay)

assets.description: flat vector industrial chemical-refining plant illustration, tanks, pipes, and scale piping -- no character
flat vector raw ore rock chunk, simple faceted shape with a subtle mixed-mineral color pattern
used_in: THE RECIPE 'digging is the easy part' beat

motion_graphics_no_generation_needed.description: rubber-stamp/signature graphic that stamps down or withholds, built in Remotion (SVG + interpolate) -- the central 'stamp' metaphor payoff. Used at the Opening, end of THE TRAP, and the closing line.
line chart climbing, for the 'prices spiked sixfold' beat in THE CLOCK
countdown/calendar graphic ticking toward Nov 10 2026, for THE CLOCK's ticking-deadline beat
reusable black title-card template with progressive word-by-word reveal, reuse Overlays.tsx / ProgressiveReveal.tsx, one per chapter boundary

Vox-styled full-screen text card, no character -- 'quote' variant (big quotation marks + attribution chip) replaces the deng-era-figure quote beat; 'statement' variant (bold centered line) replaces narrator-analyst's direct-address beats. Built in TextCard.tsx.

two-pane message/transcript infographic (labeled speaker cards, active side highlighted) replacing the SplitPhoneCall two-character exchange -- no faces, just Vox-styled text cards. Built in DialogueCards.tsx.
